recommendation: Keep the no-change audit as-is. Revisit only if a future generated table of contents diverges from the source heading structure for terminologies.html#example.
issue_request: FHIR-37454 was a Published/Persuasive Vocab technical correction for FHIR-core terminologies.html#example. It reported that Example Binding Strength appeared nested under Preferred while the other binding strengths were one header level below Binding Strengths, and requested that Example be at the same level.
initial_application: No commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-37454 was found. The apparent source correction predates the Jira issue: commit 19d78411d5a1784e71184f70e91244a6b520a575, made for other Vocab trackers, left Required, Extensible, Preferred, and Example as h4 headings under the Binding Strengths h3. Jira and Vocab minutes later recognized the R5 build as already fixed.
additional_context: source/terminologies.html is the current source for the related terminologies.html#example page. It has Binding Strengths as h3 and Required Binding Strength, Extensible Binding Strength, Preferred Binding Strength, and Example Binding Strength as sibling h4 headings. Vocab Confluence minutes for 2022-06-27 state that FHIR-37454 was not fixed in R4B but had been fixed in R5. Zulip search found no directly relevant conflicting discussion.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit on the combined branch with no source changes because the current source already satisfies the Published Jira decision.
